_howTo: To move operation X to model Y, edit operations.X: {"provider":"codex","model":"Y","fallback":[{"provider":"claude","model":"sonnet"}]}. Once explicit, edit its model line to change Y.

An entry with inherit:true preserves the existing evidence/tier router. taskTypes entries override inherited operations; operations may also use operation:taskType keys (review-seat:security, for example).
Aliases below resolve to explicit model IDs. Edit criticalWorkGate.kinds to change which operations require the existing critical-work check. A closed gate takes the Claude fallback.
Fallbacks are tried in order for unavailable providers BEFORE launch. Never retry an indeterminate or already-started launch. Invalid edits retain the last good policy and log the validation error.

Review operation judges use judge:<operation> (for example judge:review-pr); review-seat:<lens> selects an added seat. Native agent-only adapters take the first Claude entry; unsupported or missing adapters take the declared fallback. Existing CLI pins remain explicit per-run choices.

criticalWorkGate.reason: a non-Claude worker takes gated work only for a non-critical task of an opened taskType
